title: Sector Skill Execution Record
description: The observability envelope every Sector skill run appends to 01_Sector/_memory/skill_runs.jsonl. Deliberately MIRRORS the envelope that arika-runtime/src/memory-writer.ts already writes for agent runs, so a future code runtime reads one format rather than two.

_provenance.mirrors: arika-runtime/src/memory-writer.ts — {timestamp, agent, department, stream, event_type, source, payload}
_provenance.divergence: `agent` becomes `skill`; `event_type` is 'skill_run' not 'agent_run'; `source` is 'claude-code' not 'arika-runtime'. Everything else is deliberately identical.
_provenance.why_a_separate_file: 01_Sector/_memory/runtime.jsonl does not exist on disk, which is proof no Sector AGENT has ever executed through the runtime. Writing skill runs into a separate file keeps that signal readable — mixing them would destroy the evidence that the agent path is untouched.
_provenance.enforcement: NOT machine-enforced. Written by the skill, for the human and for the next session.

source.description: The apply step is a human-invoked interactive session. Not a daemon, not a cron.

execution_id.description: Stable id for this run. Reused on retry so a repeated run is recognisable as the same intent.

gate.description: The per-sector activation gate, if this run is part of one. SECTOR_ACTIVATION_PROTOCOL.md — nine gates, A through I.

context.description: The resolved Sector Execution Context. A run with an unresolved context MUST NOT reach a write — it stops and records a resolution_failure instead.

resolution_failure.description: Why context could not be resolved. Populated ONLY when resolved=false. Never 'defaulted to Hospitality'.

plugin.description: e.g. hospitality. NULL is legal — the core must resolve without a plugin (the falsification test).

plugin_slots_unavailable.description: Slots this run NEEDED but found unauthored. Recorded rather than worked around.

agent_proposal.description: Which agent proposed this, if any. NULL for the 9 databases with no proposing agent.

research_run_id.description: Shared by co-running skills. S01 and S02 MUST carry the same value.

validation.description: Which gates were run and what they returned. A skipped gate is recorded as skipped, never omitted.

decision.description: The mutation mode. Explicit on every run — never implied by what happened.

writes.description: What actually changed. Empty on NO_OP, REJECT and ESCALATE.

previous_values.description: Required on VERSION and SUPERSEDE. Historical truth is never silently overwritten.

invalidates.description: What this change makes untrue elsewhere. SECTOR_CALENDAR_REFRESH_SPEC.md §2b step 4 — 'this is the difference between a database row edit and operating-system behaviour'.

verified.description: Was the write read back and confirmed? 'Documented != applied' — SECTOR_OS_ARCHITECTURE.md §1.3 finding 6.

events.description: Events this run WOULD emit. Note: `emits` is declarative metadata in this repo — arika-runtime never calls eventBus.publish(). Recording intent is honest; claiming a publish is not.

escalation.description: What was escalated and to whom. Tier-1 architecture questions land here.
